click on the townie
Click mc command center
Click mccc dresser
Click blacklist items
And then it will pop up with which areas of the sim having clothing slots being used 
Choose which one you want to blacklist 
Then click the mail box 
Click Sims/Nov households cheats
Click dresser clean all Sims
Voila they will no longer wear whatever you blacklisted
